about: Country cards for lives born in Pakistan. Each card is dealt only to them (and a little more often than general cards). Sources are in each card's "src".

events.src: ===================== Pakistan (PK) ===================== Committees (ROSCAs): common among salaried and self-employed people; no legal contracts (HRMARS study; finclusion.org 2017). Risk is an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Friends at work run a “committee” (also called a BC): everyone pays in every month, and each month one member, picked by draw, takes the whole pot. There is no written contract; it runs on trust.

zh..x: 公司的朋友办了一个“会”（也叫BC）：每人每月交钱，每月抽签由一人拿走全部会钱。没有书面合同，全靠信任。

zht..x: 公司的朋友辦了一個「會」（也叫BC）：每人每月交錢，每月抽籤由一人拿走全部會錢。沒有書面合同，全靠信任。

events.src: The Gulf: a record $38.3bn of remittances in FY2025, $9.3bn from Saudi Arabia and $7.9bn from the UAE (State Bank of Pakistan, via Profit). Fees, pay and housing multiples are ESTIMATES.

en..x: A recruiter offers a three-year contract in Saudi Arabia or the UAE at about {a} a year, with housing provided. Those two countries sent about $17 billion of the record $38.3 billion that Pakistanis abroad sent home in 2024–25.

zh..x: 一家中介给你一份去沙特或阿联酋的三年合约，年薪约{a}，包住宿。2024–25年度巴基斯坦侨汇创下383亿美元的纪录，其中约170亿来自这两个国家。

zht..x: 一家中介給你一份去沙烏地阿拉伯或阿聯的三年合約，年薪約{a}，包住宿。2024–25年度巴基斯坦僑匯創下383億美元的紀錄，其中約170億來自這兩個國家。

events.src: Floods: in 2022 a third of the country was under water and about 33 million people were affected; damage $14.9bn and losses $15.2bn (Post-Disaster Needs Assessment, Planning Commission). The chance that a flood or storm reaches you comes from EM-DAT (people affected a year, 2000–2024: js/data.js); premiums, damage and preparation costs are ESTIMATES.

en..x: The 2022 monsoon floods put a third of Pakistan under water and affected about 33 million people; damage and losses came to about $30 billion. Your district lies in a flood plain.

zh..x: 2022年的季风水灾让巴基斯坦三分之一的土地泡在水里，约3,300万人受灾，损害和损失约300亿美元。你住的地区在洪泛平原上。

zht..x: 2022年的季風水災讓巴基斯坦三分之一的土地泡在水裡，約3,300萬人受災，損害和損失約300億美元。你住的地區在洪泛平原上。

events.src: Inflation: 38% in May 2023, a record (Pakistan Bureau of Statistics, via Business Recorder). The yearly loss is an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Inflation hit 38% in May 2023, the highest on record. Savings accounts pay less than that, so money left in rupees loses value.

zh..x: 2023年5月通胀率达到38%，创历史新高。储蓄账户的利息比这低，存在卢比里的钱会缩水。

zht..x: 2023年5月通膨率達到38%，創歷史新高。儲蓄帳戶的利息比這低，存在盧比裡的錢會縮水。

events.src: Behbood Savings Certificates: for people 60+, widows and disabled people; 12.72% a year from 4 Nov 2025, monthly profit, 10 years (National Savings, via ARY News). With inflation near 5–7% and withholding tax, about 5% real: an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Behbood Savings Certificates, for people aged 60 or more and for widows, pay a monthly profit: 12.72% a year for money put in from November 2025, for ten years.
en..buy.s: Put {a} in. About 5% a year after inflation and tax, paid monthly.

zh..x: 福利储蓄凭证（Behbood）专为60岁以上的人和寡妇设计，按月付利：2025年11月起存入的钱年利率12.72%，为期十年。
zh..buy.s: 放入{a}。扣除通胀和税后每年约5%，按月付利。

zht..x: 福利儲蓄憑證（Behbood）專為60歲以上的人和寡婦設計，按月付利：2025年11月起存入的錢年利率12.72%，為期十年。
zht..buy.s: 放入{a}。扣除通膨和稅後每年約5%，按月付利。

events.src: Solar: grid power rose from about Rs 9 a unit in 2015 to Rs 44 in 2024; about 17 GW of panels imported in 2024; net-metering buy-back being cut from Rs 27 to Rs 10 a unit (Wikipedia "Solar power in Pakistan"; Payne Institute; PIDE). System costs and savings are ESTIMATES.

go.do: const t = T('pk_solar', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.pk_solar') }); pay(c); t.v -= c; rec('pk_solar', -v, 15)

en..x: Grid power cost about Rs 44 a unit in 2024, and Pakistan imported about 17 GW of solar panels that year. Net metering lets you sell spare power back, but the buy-back rate is being cut from Rs 27 to about Rs 10 a unit.
en..solar.s: About {a} now; your bills fall by about {b} a year.
en..small: A few panels and an inverter
en..small.s: About {a} now; your bills fall by about {b} a year.

zh..x: 2024年电网电价约每度44卢比，那一年巴基斯坦进口了约17吉瓦的太阳能板。净计量制度让你把多余的电卖回电网，但收购价正从每度27卢比降到约10卢比。
zh..small: 几块板子加一台逆变器

zht..x: 2024年電網電價約每度44盧比，那一年巴基斯坦進口了約17吉瓦的太陽能板。淨計量制度讓你把多餘的電賣回電網，但收購價正從每度27盧比降到約10盧比。
zht..small: 幾塊板子加一台逆變器

events.src: EOBI: employers pay 5% and workers 1% of the minimum wage; a pension of at least Rs 10,000 a month from July 2023, at 60 (55 for women) after 15 years (OECD Pensions at a Glance Asia/Pacific 2024; Dawn). Rs 120,000 a year ÷ a full year at the minimum wage (Rs 444,000) ≈ 0.27.

en..x: You can ask your employer to register you with EOBI, the old-age pension fund: the employer pays 5% and you 1% of the minimum wage. After 15 years of contributions you get at least Rs 10,000 a month from 60 (55 for women).
en..reg.s: About {a} a year from your pay; a pension of at least {b} a year later.

zh..x: 你可以请雇主帮你登记员工养老福利机构（EOBI）：雇主付最低工资的5%，你付1%。缴满15年后，60岁（女性55岁）起每月至少领10,000卢比。
zh..reg.s: 每年从薪水扣约{a}；以后每年至少领{b}的养老金。

zht..x: 你可以請僱主幫你登記員工養老福利機構（EOBI）：僱主付最低薪水的5%，你付1%。繳滿15年後，60歲（女性55歲）起每月至少領10,000盧比。
zht..reg.s: 每年從薪水扣約{a}；以後每年至少領{b}的退休金。

events.src: School: free and compulsory education for children 5–16 (Constitution, Article 25-A, 2010); low-fee private schools are common. Fees and outcomes are ESTIMATES.

go.do: if (a) { T('pk_school', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.schoolFees') }); rec('pk_school', a, 12); } kidWin(p, .75)

en..x: The Constitution guarantees free schooling for children aged 5 to 16, and many families also choose low-fee private schools.
en..top.h: A good chance of a university scholarship later.
en..low.h: Some chance of a scholarship later.
en..govt.h: A smaller chance of a scholarship later.

zh..x: 宪法保障5到16岁的孩子免费上学，很多家庭也会选择收费低的私立学校。
zh..top.h: 以后拿大学奖学金的机会大。
zh..low.h: 以后有一些机会拿奖学金。
zh..govt.h: 以后拿奖学金的机会较小。

zht..x: 憲法保障5到16歲的孩子免費上學，很多家庭也會選擇收費低的私立學校。
zht..top.h: 以後拿大學獎學金的機會大。
zht..low.h: 以後有一些機會拿獎學金。
zht..govt.h: 以後拿獎學金的機會較小。

events.src: Plot files: in October 2022 the Lahore Development Authority declared 116 housing societies illegal, and more than 250 schemes in Lahore were reported to be operating illegally (Profit, Dec 2022); some developers sold plot “files” with no land behind them (Zameen), and the LDA advises buyers to check a scheme’s status first. Amounts are compared with a year at the federal minimum wage, Rs37,000 a month (Rs444,000), unchanged in the FY2025-26 budget (Profit, Jun 2025). Returns and odds are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: A property dealer has “files” for plots in a new housing society on the edge of the city. Their price has doubled in two years, he says. Plots in an older, approved society cost more.
en..file: Buy a file in the new society
en..file.h: Files trade on hope; some societies have no approval or even no land.
en..approved: A plot in an approved society
en.trk.pk_plot: A plot in an approved society

zh..x: 房产中介手上有城郊一个新住宅社区的地块“档案”。他说两年就涨了一倍。已获批准的老社区地块比较贵。
zh..file.h: 档案靠预期炒作；有些社区根本没被批准，甚至没有地。

zht..x: 房產仲介手上有城郊一個新住宅社區的地塊「檔案」。他說兩年就漲了一倍。已獲核准的老社區地塊比較貴。
zht..file.h: 檔案靠預期炒作；有些社區根本沒被核准，甚至沒有地。

events.src: Illegal housing societies are listed by development authorities in newspaper notices; buyers often wait years or lose most of their money (LDA notices; Profit, 2022). Sizes are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: lots.pk_file.v = 0; lots.pk_file.tout += .3 * v; cash += .3 * v; happy -= 2

en..t: The society is on the illegal list
en..x: The development authority’s newspaper notice lists your housing society as illegal. Your file, once worth {a}, can barely be sold.
en..wait: Hold on and hope it gets approved
en..wait.s: The developer promises it will be sorted out.
en..wait.h: Happiness −3; the file is worth well under half.

zh..x: 开发局在报上的公告把你那个社区列为非法。你那份曾经值{a}的档案几乎卖不掉了。
zh..wait.h: 幸福感 −3；档案价值剩不到一半。

zht..x: 開發局在報上的公告把你那個社區列為非法。你那份曾經值{a}的檔案幾乎賣不掉了。
zht..wait.h: 幸福感 −3；檔案價值剩不到一半。

events.src: Weddings: mehndi, baraat and walima often run over three days, and the bride’s family is expected to give jahez (dowry goods); the Dowry and Bridal Gifts (Restriction) Act 1976 limits dowry, and Punjab’s Marriage Functions Act 2016 allows only one dish and limits hours, but both are loosely enforced. Amounts are compared with a year at the federal minimum wage, Rs37,000 a month (Rs444,000), unchanged in the FY2025-26 budget (Profit, Jun 2025). Amounts are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Your child is getting married. The relatives are already planning the mehndi, the baraat and the walima, and asking about the jahez.
en..big: Three days, the way the family expects
en..big.h: Happiness +2; the family’s name is upheld.
en..simple: Nikah at home and a small walima
en..simple.h: Some relatives grumble; the couple starts without debt.

zh..x: 你的孩子要结婚了。亲戚已经在张罗彩绘礼、迎亲和喜宴，还在问嫁妆的事。
zh..big: 办三天，照家族的规矩来
zh..simple: 在家办证婚，加一场小喜宴
zh..simple.h: 有些亲戚抱怨；新人没有负担地开始。

zht..x: 你的孩子要結婚了。親戚已經在張羅彩繪禮、迎親和喜宴，還在問嫁妝的事。
zht..big: 辦三天，照家族的規矩來
zht..simple: 在家辦證婚，加一場小喜宴
zht..simple.h: 有些親戚抱怨；新人沒有負擔地開始。

events.src: Car finance: the State Bank caps car loans at Rs3 million, with at least 30% down and five years at most (SBP prudential regulations, 2022). Buyers often pay dealers an “own money” premium to skip months-long waits. A small new car (about Rs3 million ≈ 6.8 of the game’s yardstick), the premium and a used car’s price are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with a year at the federal minimum wage, Rs37,000 a month (Rs444,000), unchanged in the FY2025-26 budget (Profit, Jun 2025).

opts.do: pay(2 * base); car = { type: 'new', bal: 4.8 * base, pay: carPay(4.8 * base) }; T('car', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.carNew') }); happy += 2
pay(2.5 * base); car = { type: 'new', bal: 4.8 * base, pay: carPay(4.8 * base) }; const t = T('car', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.carNew') }); t.spent += .5 * base; t.g += .5 * base; happy += 3
car = { type: 'used', bal: 0, pay: 0 }; pay(1.5 * base); const t = T('car', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.carUsed') }); t.spent += 1.5 * base; t.g += 1.5 * base; happy += 1

en..x: You want a car for the family. The dealer’s waiting list for a new one is six months, unless you pay him “own money” to jump the queue.
en..wait: Book it on a bank loan and wait
en..wait.h: Happiness +2 when it comes; the loan costs interest.
en..own: Pay “own money” and drive it home this week
en..own.s: {a} up front, then about {b} a year.
en..own.h: Happiness +3; the premium is money gone.

zh..x: 你想给家里买辆车。新车要排六个月，除非付车商一笔“插队费”（own money）。
zh..wait: 用银行贷款订车，慢慢等
zh..wait.h: 车到了幸福感 +2；贷款要付利息。
zh..own: 付插队费，这周就开回家
zh..own.h: 幸福感 +3；插队费就是白花的钱。

zht..x: 你想給家裡買台車。新車要排六個月，除非付車商一筆「插隊費」（own money）。
zht..wait: 用銀行貸款訂車，慢慢等
zht..wait.h: 車到了幸福感 +2；貸款要付利息。
zht..own: 付插隊費，這週就開回家
zht..own.h: 幸福感 +3；插隊費就是白花的錢。

events.src: Freelancing: Pakistan has over 2.3 million freelancers (freelancers’ union, via Arab News); in 2024 internet speeds fell 30–40% as a national firewall was installed, and the software houses’ association warned of losses up to $300 million (WISPAP and P@SHA, via Arab News, Aug 2024). Amounts are compared with a year at the federal minimum wage, Rs37,000 a month (Rs444,000), unchanged in the FY2025-26 budget (Profit, Jun 2025). Earnings and odds are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('pk_fl', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.pk_fl')}); rec('pk_fl', -.3 * base, 6, -.3); happy -= 1

en..x: A cousin earns in dollars on Upwork after his day job, designing logos for clients abroad. He says you could do it too.
en..start.s: Paid in dollars, at the hours clients want.
en..start.h: Extra income worth about a third of a minimum wage a year; Health a little lower from late nights.

zh..x: 一个表亲下班后在Upwork上接案，帮国外客户设计商标，赚的是美元。他说你也可以。
zh..start.s: 收美元，配合客户的时间。
zh..start.h: 每年多出大约三分之一个最低工资的收入；熬夜让健康少一点。

zht..x: 一個表親下班後在Upwork上接案，幫國外客戶設計商標，賺的是美元。他說你也可以。
zht..start.s: 收美元，配合客戶的時間。
zht..start.h: 每年多出大約三分之一個最低工資的收入；熬夜讓健康少一點。

events.src: Internet slowdowns and outages hit freelancers repeatedly in 2024–2025 (Arab News; Profit, Aug 2025). Costs and effects are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: The internet has slowed to a crawl for weeks. A client has cancelled because your files arrived late.
en..backup: Pay for a second connection and a VPN

zh..x: 网速已经慢了好几个星期。有个客户因为你交件太慢取消了合作。

zht..x: 網速已經慢了好幾個星期。有個客戶因為你交件太慢取消了合作。

events.src: Prime Minister’s Youth Business & Agriculture Loan Scheme: for ages 21–45, loans up to Rs0.5 million interest-free (tier 1), up to Rs1.5 million at 5% and up to Rs7.5 million at 7%, repaid over up to eight years (SBP; HBL and Bank of Khyber scheme pages, 2022–23). Rs0.5 million ≈ 1.1 of the game’s yardstick; repaid over eight years ≈ 0.14 a year. Amounts are compared with a year at the federal minimum wage, Rs37,000 a month (Rs444,000), unchanged in the FY2025-26 budget (Profit, Jun 2025). Profit and odds are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('pk_pmyb', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.pk_pmyb')}); rec('pk_pmyb', .14 * base, 8); T('pk_shop', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.pk_shop')}); rec('pk_shop', -.35 * base, 12, -.3); happy += 1

en..x: You and a friend want to open a mobile-phone repair shop. The government’s youth scheme offers loans of up to Rs0.5 million with no interest.
en..loan: Take the loan and open the shop
en..loan.s: A {a} loan, repaid at about {b} a year for eight years.
en..loan.h: A good shop earns well above the repayments; some don’t make it.

zh..x: 你和朋友想开一间手机维修店。政府的青年计划提供最多五十万卢比的无息贷款。
zh..loan.s: 贷款{a}，八年里每年还大约{b}。
zh..loan.h: 生意好的话赚的比还款多很多；但也有撑不下去的。

zht..x: 你和朋友想開一間手機維修店。政府的青年計畫提供最多五十萬盧比的無息貸款。
zht..loan.s: 貸款{a}，八年裡每年還大約{b}。
zht..loan.h: 生意好的話賺的比還款多很多；但也有撐不下去的。

events.src: ESTIMATE: game rule (small shops struggle with power cuts, rent rises and competition).

opts.do: if (roll('pk_pmyb2') < .45) happy += 1; else { stopRec('pk_shop'); pay(.1 * base); happy -= 3 }

en..x: Load-shedding cuts your hours and a bigger shop has opened across the road. Some months you barely cover the rent.
en..close.s: The loan still has to be repaid.
en..push: Buy a generator and keep going
en..push.h: Fewer than half of struggling shops recover.

zh..x: 停电让你营业时间变短，对街又开了一家大店。有几个月连房租都快付不出来。
zh..push.h: 撑不下去的店，能翻身的不到一半。

zht..x: 停電讓你營業時間變短，對街又開了一家大店。有幾個月連房租都快付不出來。
zht..push.h: 撐不下去的店，能翻身的不到一半。

events.src: Zakat at source: on the first of Ramadan, banks deduct 2.5% zakat from savings accounts above the nisab (Rs179,689 in 2025, Rs503,529 in 2026); current accounts are exempt, and a notarised CZ-50 declaration lets you pay zakat yourself instead (Zakat and Ushr Ordinance 1980; Allied Bank; Profit, Feb 2026). Amounts are compared with a year at the federal minimum wage, Rs37,000 a month (Rs444,000), unchanged in the FY2025-26 budget (Profit, Jun 2025).

opts.do: pay(a); const t = T('pk_zakat', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.pk_zakat')}); t.v -= a; happy += 1
pay(a + .005 * base); const t = T('pk_zakat', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.pk_zakat')}); t.v -= a + .005 * base; happy += 2

en..x: Ramadan is coming. On the first day, your bank will deduct 2.5% zakat from your savings account, about {a}, unless you file a declaration and pay it yourself.
en..bank.s: About {a}, collected by the state’s zakat fund.
en..self: File a CZ-50 and give it yourself
en..self.s: About {a} to people you know who need it, plus a notary’s fee.
en..self.h: Happiness +2: you see where it goes.

zh..x: 斋月快到了。第一天银行会从你的储蓄账户扣2.5%的天课，大约{a}，除非你先提交声明，自己去缴。
zh..bank.s: 大约{a}，交给政府的天课基金。
zh..self.s: 大约{a}给你认识、需要帮助的人，另加公证费。
zh..self.h: 幸福感 +2：你看得到钱用在哪里。

zht..x: 齋月快到了。第一天銀行會從你的儲蓄帳戶扣2.5%的天課，大約{a}，除非你先提交聲明，自己去繳。
zht..bank.s: 大約{a}，交給政府的天課基金。
zht..self.s: 大約{a}給你認識、需要幫助的人，另加公證費。
zht..self.h: 幸福感 +2：你看得到錢用在哪裡。

events.src: Wheat in 2024: Punjab delayed and cut its procurement, and farmers sold at Rs2,800–3,200 per 40 kg against a support price of Rs3,900 (Dawn; ProPakistani, Apr 2024). The price paths and storage losses are an ESTIMATE.

en..t: No buyer at the support price
en..x: Harvest is in, but the government hasn’t started buying wheat. Traders offer far below the support price.
en..sell.s: Cash now, at a low price.
en..sell.h: About a quarter less income this year.
en..store: Store it and wait for a better price
en..store.s: Rent for storage, and a gamble on prices.
en..store.h: Prices may recover, or fall further.

zh..x: 小麦收成了，可是政府还没开始收购。商贩开的价比保证价低很多。
zh..sell.h: 今年收入大约少四分之一。
zh..store.s: 要付仓储费，赌价格会回升。
zh..store.h: 价格可能回升，也可能跌更多。

zht..x: 小麥收成了，可是政府還沒開始收購。商販開的價比保證價低很多。
zht..sell.h: 今年收入大約少四分之一。
zht..store.s: 要付倉儲費，賭價格會回升。
zht..store.h: 價格可能回升，也可能跌更多。

events.src: Filers and non-filers: people not on FBR’s active taxpayer list pay higher withholding taxes, e.g. 0.8% on cash withdrawals above Rs50,000 a day (Budget 2025-26), and higher rates on buying property and cars, with limits on large purchases (Zameen; ICT tax guide, 2025). Amounts are compared with a year at the federal minimum wage, Rs37,000 a month (Rs444,000), unchanged in the FY2025-26 budget (Profit, Jun 2025). The adviser’s fee and the taxes saved are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: spend('pk_adv', .02 * base, 'trk.pk_adv'); T('pk_filer', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.pk_filer')}); rec('pk_filer', -.01 * base, 30)

en..x: Your tax is deducted from your salary, but you have never filed a return. A friend says non-filers pay extra tax on almost everything.
en..file.s: About {a} a year for the adviser.
en..file.h: Lower withholding taxes on bank withdrawals, property and cars.
en..skip.h: Extra withholding tax on many transactions, for years.

zh..x: 你的税是从薪水直接扣的，可是你从来没报过税。朋友说没报税的人几乎什么都要多缴税。
zh..file.h: 提款、买房、买车的预扣税都比较低。
zh..skip.h: 很多交易都要多缴预扣税，一缴好多年。

zht..x: 你的稅是從薪水直接扣的，可是你從來沒報過稅。朋友說沒報稅的人幾乎什麼都要多繳稅。
zht..file.h: 提款、買房、買車的預扣稅都比較低。
zht..skip.h: 很多交易都要多繳預扣稅，一繳好多年。

events.src: CSS exam: the Federal Public Service Commission’s competitive exam for the civil service, where only a few percent of candidates pass the written papers each year (FPSC annual reports). The pass chance for a serious candidate (4%), the preparation year and the pay and pension effects are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with a year at the federal minimum wage, Rs37,000 a month (Rs444,000), unchanged in the FY2025-26 budget (Profit, Jun 2025).

later.pk_css: if (roll('pk_css') < .04) { bump('pk_css', 1.05, M('trk.pk_css')); layM = (layM || 1) * .1; penM = (penM || 1) * 1.3; happy += 6; log(M('log.pk_cssOk'), 'good') } else { log(M('log.pk_cssNo'), 'bad'); happy -= 2 }

en..x: Your father still talks about the uncle who became a deputy commissioner. He wants you to take a year off and sit the CSS exam.
en..try: Join an academy and prepare for a year
en..try.s: Academy fees, and a year with almost no pay.
en..try.h: Happiness −2. Only a few percent pass; officers get secure, respected careers and a good pension.
en.trk.pk_cssP: A year preparing for the CSS
en.log.pk_cssOk: You passed the CSS exam and joined the civil service.
en.log.pk_cssNo: You didn’t pass the CSS written papers, and go back to work.

zh..x: 你爸还常提起那个当上副专员的叔叔。他希望你休息一年去考CSS。
zh..try.s: 学院学费，还有一年几乎没收入。
zh..try.h: 幸福感 −2。考上的只有百分之几；考上的人有稳定又受尊敬的职业和不错的退休金。
zh.log.pk_cssOk: 你考上CSS，进了公务员体系。
zh.log.pk_cssNo: 你没考过CSS笔试，回去上班。

zht..x: 你爸還常提起那個當上副專員的叔叔。他希望你休息一年去考CSS。
zht..try.s: 學院學費，還有一年幾乎沒收入。
zht..try.h: 幸福感 −2。考上的只有百分之幾；考上的人有穩定又受尊敬的職業和不錯的退休金。
zht.log.pk_cssOk: 你考上CSS，進了公務員體系。
zht.log.pk_cssNo: 你沒考過CSS筆試，回去上班。

events.src: Instalment buying (qist): shops and qist companies sell fridges, phones and motorbikes on monthly instalments with a mark-up, often 25–50% over the cash price for a year (shop price lists, 2025: ESTIMATE). A fridge (Rs120,000 ≈ 0.27 of the game’s yardstick) is an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with a year at the federal minimum wage, Rs37,000 a month (Rs444,000), unchanged in the FY2025-26 budget (Profit, Jun 2025).

en..x: Summer is coming and the old fridge has died. The shop will let you take a new one home today, paid in twelve monthly qists.
en..qist.h: Happiness +2 now; the mark-up is about half the cash price.
en..none.s: Buy ice from the shop next door.

zh..x: 夏天要到了，旧冰箱坏了。店家说今天就能把新冰箱载回家，分十二期付款。
zh..qist.h: 现在幸福感 +2；加价大约是现金价的一半。

zht..x: 夏天要到了，舊冰箱壞了。店家說今天就能把新冰箱載回家，分十二期付款。
zht..qist.h: 現在幸福感 +2；加價大約是現金價的一半。
